note: `python -m nestor` failed ('No module named nestor.__main__'). Several positional CLI arguments and flags had no --help text, so `nestor ask --help` showed 'text' with no description.

decisions.question: Should Nestor support `python -m nestor` invocation?
decisions.commitment: Added `nestor/__main__.py` — a three-line module that delegates to `nestor.cli:main`. Filled in missing help text for positional arguments (text, surface, label, observed) and the --engine/--domain flags.
decisions.why: Agents and developers who haven't installed the console script (editable installs, CI containers) reach for `python -m <pkg>` as the universal fallback. Missing help text makes `--help` output look broken to a new user scanning for what an argument does.
